entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: A female flamekin pilgrim from Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, the last flamekin born at Mount Tanufel, who becomes the Destroyer in Shadowmoor and later atones.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: The plane that cycles between sunny Lorwyn and its benighted counterpart Shadowmoor at the Great Aurora.

entities.name: Greater elemental
entities.description: A wild greater elemental that ignited Ashling's fires and later appears as a great white steed with unquenchable fire; she absorbs its power.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: A treefolk sage who hires Ashling as messenger and secretly plots to shape her destiny; he is set ablaze by the elemental.

entities.name: Colfenor's sapling
entities.description: The sapling of Colfenor who pursues Ashling to see the plan reach fruition and is set ablaze in the ritual.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: A Gilt-Leaf elf outlawed from his tribe and Colfenor's apprentice; he later makes a death pact with Maralen and dissolves into Eirdu's light.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: An uncanny elf and fae duplicate bearing a piece of Oona's soul who becomes faerie queen; Oko's sister.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The queen of the fae, defeated in Shadowmoor and feared to be returning through Maralen.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: A Kithkin folk hero who guides Ashling and nearly kills her.

entities.name: Gaddock Teeg
entities.description: Leader of Kinsbaile who sends Ashling on her way.

entities.name: Vendilion clique
entities.description: Mischievous fae siblings who accompany Ashling.

entities.name: Nath
entities.description: An occupying Gilt-Leaf taercenn at Kinsbaile.

entities.name: Brion
entities.description: A nettlevine-choked giant freed from Gilt-Leaf captivity.

entities.name: Kiel
entities.description: A nettlevine-choked giant freed from Gilt-Leaf captivity.

entities.name: Vigilant Eidren of Wilt-Leaf
entities.description: Died repelling Ashling from Mistmeadow.

entities.name: Warree Tarcha
entities.description: A kithkin augur whose protective magic repelled Ashling from Kinscaer.

entities.name: Captain Sygg
entities.description: Helped subdue the Destroyer.

entities.name: Rosheen Meanderer
entities.description: Author of the scroll that aids Maralen.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Maralen's apparent brother who disguises himself as a faerie and orchestrates the Goldmeadow ordeal.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: Shadowmoor's elemental incarnation, who walks out of accordance with the cycle.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: The elemental incarnation of Lorwyn who rebalances the cycle.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: A Gilt-Leaf perfect who plots to destroy Isilu to bring about endless daylight.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf
entities.description: An elf tribe that outlaws and hunts Rhys.

entities.name: Flamekin
entities.description: Fire elementals who follow the Path of Flame; changed into cinders by the Great Aurora.

entities.name: Mount Tanufel
entities.description: Mountain where Ashling was born and where the ritual takes place.

entities.name: Kinsbaile
entities.description: Kithkin town led by Gaddock Teeg.

entities.name: Murmuring Bosk
entities.description: Place where Rhys is to perform his duty for Colfenor.

entities.name: Goldmeadow
entities.description: Kithkin town enveloped in unnatural night by Isilu.

entities.name: Ember Fell monastery
entities.description: Flamekin monastery on Mount Tanufel where Ashling faces her trial.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: The event that turns Lorwyn into Shadowmoor and flamekin into cinders.

entities.name: Path of Flame
entities.description: The flamekin way toward personal enlightenment.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Plane from which two wayward students travel with Maralen.

events.summary: Ashling begins a pilgrimage through Lorwyn, searching for the greater elemental of her birth.
events.quote: In 4520 AR , Ashling journeyed on a pilgrimage through Lorwyn

events.summary: Ashling takes a messenger job from Colfenor, gains the Vendilion clique and Brigid Baeli as companions at Kinsbaile.
events.quote: Ashling had accepted a seemingly innocuous messenger job from the treefolk sage Colfenor

events.summary: Ashling meets Rhys and Maralen, who is later revealed to be a fae duplicate bearing a piece of Oona's soul.
events.quote: Maralen was a fae duplicate

events.summary: At the Festival of Tales Gilt-Leaf soldiers ambush the party; Ashling repels the arrows with fire.
events.quote: Ashling protected her new friends valiantly

events.summary: Brigid drenches Ashling, nearly killing her; the greater elemental appears, rekindles her fire and sets Colfenor ablaze.
events.quote: A surge of energy from the elemental's blessing rekindled her fire and set Colfenor ablaze, obliterating the yew.

events.summary: Ashling ascends a step on the Path of Flame, able to will her flame white, and leaves in flame with the elemental after helping free the giants.
events.quote: she also ascended a step on the Path of Flame, being able to will her red flame to a white one

events.summary: Ashling resolves to claim the elemental's power for herself rather than seek its guidance.
events.quote: instead to claim its power, fully, for herself

events.summary: Ashling climbs Mount Tanufel, meets monks of the Ember Fell monastery and joins forces with Colfenor's sapling.
events.quote: The two joined forces to complete one of the tests set for Ashling by the monks.

events.summary: In the Ember Fell trial Ashling restores fire to ghostly flamekin and learns she is meant to be a vessel for the flamekin fire.
events.quote: a vessel to bring the flamekin fire through the shadowy future

events.summary: At the Great Aurora ritual Ashling seizes the elemental's power and the sapling's knowledge by force, absorbing them; some energy goes to Maralen.
events.quote: she seized the unsuspecting elemental's power and the sapling's knowledge by force

events.summary: Lorwyn gives way to Shadowmoor and Ashling becomes one of its mightiest beings.
events.quote: Lorwyn gave place to the dreadful Shadowmoor, with Ashling becoming one of the mightiest beings on it.

events.summary: In Shadowmoor Ashling becomes the Extinguisher, called the Destroyer, worshiped and scorned by the cinders.
events.quote: Ashling became the Extinguisher , also known as the "Destroyer" to the other races.

events.summary: Ashling lays waste to many places but is repelled from Mistmeadow and Kinscaer.
events.quote: Ashling laid waste to many places in Shadowmoor.

events.summary: Maralen, Brigid, Captain Sygg and the Source of the Wanderbrine subdue the Destroyer; Maralen gains the elemental power instead of Oona.
events.quote: but Maralen, aided by the scroll of Rosheen Meanderer , gained the power instead

events.summary: Reduced to a flamekin again, Ashling repents and helps Maralen's party defeat and destroy Oona.
events.quote: repented for her actions and tried to atone by helping Maralen's party defeat and destroy Oona

events.summary: Around 4522 Ashling ventures to the Primal Beyond to better understand the plane's duality.
events.quote: Around 4522, she ventured to the Primal Beyond at the edge of Lorwyn

events.summary: Ashling, now free of her Destroyer persona, becomes a rimekin in Shadowmoor and can keep those near her in Lorwyn form.
events.quote: she now became a rimekin when entering Shadowmoor

events.summary: Maralen seeks Ashling's help as Oona's consciousness reasserts itself, bringing news of Isilu and Morcant's plot; they travel to Goldmeadow.
events.quote: Ashling was approached by Maralen in her time of crisis

events.summary: Ashling and the others fight the Shadowmoor-afflicted kithkin and Gilt-Leaf elves; Rhys catches Maralen and fatally strikes her as their pact demanded.
events.quote: Rhys managed to catch up to Maralen and fatally struck her just as their pact had demanded of him.

events.summary: Oko reveals he orchestrated the ordeal, falsely convinced Maralen and Rhys of Oona's return, and cures his sister.
events.quote: Making amends, he cured his sister, and the two were able to reconcile.

events.summary: Eirdu and Isilu reunite, rebalancing the plane's cycle; Rhys, freed of the pact's magic, dissolves into Eirdu's light.
events.quote: Ashling then watched as he dissolved into Eirdu's light.

relations.note: Colfenor hired Ashling as messenger and manipulated her destiny
relations.quote: Unbeknownst to her, this all was a plan of the ancient yew sage.

relations.note: she kept close to him and protected him
relations.quote: the flamekin decided to keep close to him

relations.note: kept in touch and helped her
relations.quote: although keeping in touch still with Maralen

relations.note: Maralen bore a piece of Oona's soul

relations.quote: to serve as her guide as she departed the town

relations.note: she comes to resent it and absorbs its power
relations.quote: The elemental was absorbed by her

rejected.quote: help Maralen's party defeat and destroy Oona
